lines.zh: 我走路的姿势是学来的
lines.en: This walk is borrowed.
I studied it for a long time.

lines.zh: 我踩下去的位置分毫不差
lines.en: My steps land exactly right.
I follow its route.
Do you recognize this gait?
I am half a beat behind the original.
I step toward you.
My shadow is not right yet.
I walk stiffly.

lines.zh: 我换了三个样子走到这
lines.en: I wore three shapes to get here.
I stand, imitating well.
I am practicing its stance.
You have passed me many times.
My fingers are slightly long.
I wait for fewer people.
I never make the first move.
I am not used to this shape.
I stare into the distance.
I am quiet, like a villager.
No one notices me.

lines.zh: 我学它的样子站着，学得太像。
lines.en: I stand the way it stood, a little too well.
I tuck my hands away.
My breathing is learned.
I wait for you to relax.
I am counting your rhythm.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到更暗的地方
lines.en: I drift to a darker spot.
Look at my eyes.

lines.zh: 是的，只有眼睛不太一样
lines.en: Yes, only the eyes are a little off.
I did well, did I not?
You almost mistook me.
I cannot blink; I never learned.

lines.zh: 我记住你的走路方式了
lines.en: I have your walk memorized.
You are hunting for the flaw.
Your companions cannot tell either.

lines.zh: 我和他站在一起，你选谁
lines.en: I stand beside him; which is which?
The corner of my mouth is always off.
Do not lean in for a close look.
You are starting to doubt. Good.
This face is borrowed.

lines.zh: 你叫它的名字，我不会应
lines.en: Call its name; I will not answer.
My face slipped.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方不太像人
lines.en: The place you hit was not quite human.
I step back and rearrange myself.
That showed a little of me.
I grit my teeth; they do not line up.
My voice is slightly wrong.
You are becoming certain, are you not?
I can still hold this shape.
Do not call the others.
Hit me again and I change faces.

lines.zh: 它喜欢这个，所以我也喜欢
lines.en: It likes this, so I do too.
What is that in your hand?
I reach out as it would.
I may not actually eat it.
You hand it over so trustingly.
I cannot taste anything.
He reaches; so do I.
You may hand it to either of us.
I hold it properly, like it would.
Do not look at my hands.
My shoulder is harder than his.
You hesitated when you hit me.
You still are not sure who I am.
I step back, copying his reaction.
My body is a little cold.
You felt something wrong.
We collided like an accident.
You did not see my face clearly.

lines.zh: 下次撞上，也许就不是我
lines.en: Next time it may not be me you hit.
I am not even myself.

lines.zh: 我借来的样子不该谈这个
lines.en: A borrowed shape should not speak of this.
Who are you speaking to?
This I cannot imitate.
Do not ask me; ask him.
I am merely standing here.
That makes it hard to hold the shape.
This face of mine is about to slip.

lines.zh: 换个话题，我快撑不住了
lines.en: Change the subject; I cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的姿势和他一样
lines.en: I bend just as he does.

lines.zh: 东西我捡了，动作很自然
lines.en: I picked it up; the motion was natural.
You saw no difference.
I hand it back his way.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到它时不一样
lines.en: It feels different against my fingers.
I will take this.
You will not have time to stop me.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，谁都可能捡
lines.en: Anyone might pick up what falls.

lines.zh: 我捡得很慢，为了让你看清
lines.en: I pick it up slowly so you see.
Look again; my hand will be empty.
You are easy to find in a crowd.
I approached in another shape.
Who was it you spoke to just now?
I have been beside you.
Did you count everyone?
I keep up without running.
I have your scent.

lines.zh: 你已经开始怀疑所有人
lines.en: You are starting to doubt everyone.
I am an arm's length away.

lines.zh: 你回头看见的，不一定是我
lines.en: What you see when you turn may not be me.
I have chosen your shape.
Your companions will not believe you.
I have been listening to you.

lines.zh: 你已经在我视线里很久了
lines.en: You have been in my sight a long while.
I have begun following you.
Do not shout; it will not help.
I walk behind your group.
I changed faces once.
Did you count heads when you turned?
I stay just too far to hear.
I listen while you talk.
I slip around behind the tree.
Your companion was not there a moment ago.
I copy their laughter.
You have gone quiet.
You dare not confirm who is who.
I never fall a step behind.
Speed up and I do the same.
I look most natural among people.
You split up. Perfect.
I am two blocks behind him.
Your gaze passed over me.
I have not been recognized.
You should count them.
I am beginning to look like him.

lines.zh: 最后一次你看见的是我
lines.en: The last one you see will be me.

lines.zh: 这一下用的是他的力气
lines.en: This blow uses his strength.
You looked at me as you were hit.
My expression never changed once.
My movement looks very human.

lines.zh: 你还没决定要不要还手
lines.en: You have not decided whether to hit back.
This one did not carry much weight.
I strike and step away.
My nails are longer than his.
Step back and look at my eyes.
I am not angry; I am learning.

lines.zh: 再一下，你就不会怀疑了
lines.en: One more and you will stop doubting.
My timing is off.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，我不再装了
lines.en: After this, I stop pretending.
Did you get a clear look?
Have you counted everyone?

lines.zh: 这个村子的某个人换了
lines.en: Someone in this village has changed.
I step out of the crowd.
My eyes differ from his by a little.

lines.zh: 我花了一天学这个形状
lines.en: It took a day to learn this shape.
You greeted me a moment ago.
My arrival was perfectly natural.

lines.zh: 你身后的同伴多了一个
lines.en: There is one more companion behind you.
I need no spawn egg.
I stand among them.
Do you remember how many there were?
I walk slowly into the light.
The people here are easy to learn.
I never left.
This is the face you saw first.
I keep my hands in my pockets.
I try not to blink.
Your instinct is warning you.
I saved you a place.
Firelight shows my flaw.
My shape came apart on landing.
Water washes my outline away.
The blast took half my face.
The arrow pierced this borrowed skin.

lines.zh: 法术把我钉在这个形状里
lines.en: The spell pinned me to this shape.

lines.zh: 我学不会饿，但学得会虚弱
lines.en: I cannot learn hunger, but I can learn weakness.
Lightning showed my true form.
There is no one here to imitate.
